primary: FM-trained head applied to a separately trained GAGA parent, without any GAGA force labels used to train that transferred head. Compare to GAGA parent and own-head GAGA on the identical initial draws. Require positive joint-yield gain in every new fit and positive composition95 interval; also report crossed fit/composition uncertainty.
secondary: Reverse transfer from GAGA head to FM, and retained fraction of the own-head improvement. No head selection, recalibration or hydrogen readout.
scope: Head weights are transferred verbatim within each independently trained fit pair. Parent architectures and element vocabularies match; objectives, source laws, samplers and head-training trajectories differ. Test same previously fixed64 compositions; old-fit target outcomes already exist, while all three new-fit outcomes remain ungenerated. All results retained regardless of sign; no universal transfer claim.
